correctness.rationale: The claim concerns exactly the three-affine-factor system Eq. (3.13), not a generic three-population game. Reconstructed all 3^3 boundary/interior status assignments over [0,1]^3 for the published calibration: precisely the eight corners and (34/37,40/41,0), (6/37,8/41,1), (517/1248,71/156,3329/4992) survive. Exact independent symbolic computation verifies det J*=-BE(A+D)x(1-x)y(1-y)z(1-z)<0 and tr J*=0 under B,E,A+D>0, proving one negative and two positive-real-part eigenvalues at any admissible fully mixed point. Face xy blocks have negative determinant, and exact transverse eigenvalues -46606/1517 and -23282/1517 establish one unstable direction each. This is exhaustive only at the stated baseline; general theorem covers interior point uniqueness and index, not every degenerate boundary case.
